A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] worked as a '''senior magistrate''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Concord Dawn/Legends|Concord Dawn]]. He was sympathetic to the anti-[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Diversity Alliance]], and delivered some Human prisoners from Concord Dawn to [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] for the Alliance. His fate after the alliance crumbled is unknown but it is possible he was arrested by the Journeyman Protectors and executed.
